messages:
alex: Heads up — infra CI is failing repeatedly on the tf-gke repo. Multiple runs today hit runner allocation + cache restore errors. First failure: "nodepool quota exceeded" then a helm-sync timeout. Logs:
```
Error: failed to create nodepool: quotaExceeded for GPUs in europe-west1
helm repo update: context deadline exceeded
RestoreCache failed with 403 from gcs-cache
```
maria: Ugh. Which workflow? apply pipeline or canary?
josh: The apply workflow — the concurrency group is still defaulted so we get parallel applies queued, then GPU provisioning spikes and quota gets exhausted.
kevin: We've had a quota pressure event in europe-west1 this morning from partner runs. Suggest fall back to europe-west4 or reduce concurrent applies.
sre-oncall: I opened a dashboard (link: https://dash.redwood.internal/gpu/quota) — shows 3x provisioning peaks at 08:12–08:20 UTC. Also seeing nodepreemption events.
maria: Quick fix: can we set concurrency: group: tf-gke-apply to 1 so GH actions serializes applies? That will buy time.
ajex: (typo) alex: I'll make a PR to set concurrency group and also decrease max-parallelism for executor. Anyone object?
josh: Also disable the cache restore step for helm charts — looks like the cache key is colliding and returns 403 intermittently. Replace with a gcs download with retries: 
```
- name: fetch-helm-cache
  run: |
    gsutil -m cp gs://redwood-ci/helm-cache.tgz ./
    tar xzf helm-cache.tgz
  continue-on-error: true
```
kevin: For region fallback we need to ensure tf variables allow region override. Current infra pins europe-west1 in a lot of modules. That will need a small param patch.
ci-bot: [auto] Workflow run 1472: retry scheduled (attempt 2/3) after transient cache 403 on restore step.
sre-oncall: Can we also add a conservative 30s backoff + 3 retries to the runner-provision step? The cloud API sometimes returns 429s under contention.
maria: Agreed. Short-term plan: 1) set concurrency=1 for applies, 2) disable helm cache restore, 3) add retries/backoff on provision. Long-term: paramize region and add regional capacity awareness in the runner autoscaler.
alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-infra/tf-gke/pull/402 — changes concurrency to single-run for apply, adds retry wrapper for provision, and swaps helm cache step to gsutil with 3 retries. Will monitor. :eyes:
josh: If anyone hits a stuck GH runner, please ping me — I've been killing zombie runners and freeing quota.
kevin: Note for customers: if we shift to west4, some node labels differ; test will need to tolerate label changes.
alex: Thanks all — will escalate to infra on-call if we still hit >5 failures/hour. For now monitoring and patching. :thumbsup:
